acceptance: After the verdict lands, make pr-rerun (or the documented next step in the gate's failure message) re-runs the failed gate job, covered by a test of the selection logic
The gate's failure text names the exact command to use
context: Observed on PR 3577 at head f81dd929c: gate job in run 40497431237 failed with exit code 3 at 2026-10-27T11:36Z; oracle-verdict then passed; make pr-rerun (scripts/pr_rerun.py) only inspects the CI run 40497431205. Not checked whether the gate would also re-run itself on a later event (it did not before the manual rerun). Filed from session review 2026-10-27.
description: The oracle-gate workflow's gate job fails with 'waiting for the oracle's verdict on <sha> ... rerun this check after it lands' when it starts before the verdict exists. After the verdict landed, make pr-rerun answered 'CI run <id> on <sha> succeeded; nothing to re-run' and the failed gate stayed red until the run was re-run by hand with gh run rerun <run> --failed. The gate then passed.
